title: Allowit local execution request v1

amount.description: Positive USDC budget charge, maximum 1000000: ceil(quantity * fixed test rate * 10^6) / 10^6 plus sum of all call maxCostUSDC. Test rates: SOL=100, XLM=0.1, USDC=1; never market quotes.

recipient.description: Valid Solana 32-byte base58 or Stellar checksummed G/C/M address. No recipient allowlist unless policy imposes one.

context.description: Evidence claims as JSON. Combined with server-added allowitExecution: maximum 16 KiB, depth 8 and 128 entries. Do not supply allowitExecution.

quantity.description: Positive decimal: SOL at most 9 places, XLM 7, USDC 6. SOL only on Solana; XLM only on Stellar.

memo.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Mock metadata, not a signed on-chain memo.

data.description: Canonical padded base64, at most 1024 decoded bytes; no executable script.

contract.description: Solana program address or Stellar C address; same rail as transfer.

args.description: At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; contributes to combined context limits.

maxCostUSDC.description: Maximum additional mock cost; zero is allowed. Charged in full.

description: Local dev only. Semantic validation also enforces addresses, asset/rail matching, exact amounts, UTF-8 byte limits and combined context limits. Transactions run before[] in order, transfer, then after[] in order as mock records. Calls require policy pass and an additional exact-plan owner answer. No RPC, provider delivery, arbitrary URL or real settlement.
